newsitem.title: USA: Houston Ship Channel shut down by morning fog.
newsitem.headline: Houston Ship Channel shut down by morning fog.

text.p: The Houston Ship Channel was shut Wednesday morning as a heavy fog blanketed the area, delaying four inbound and four outbound deep-draft ships, shipping officials said.
The channel was shut at 0500 CST/1100 GMT by the U.S. Coast Guard and shipping officials, and will reopen once the fog lifts, the officials said.
"Traffic's pretty much at a standstill," U.S. Coast Guard Petty Officer Tom Atkisson said. "Unless the sun comes out to burn this off, this stuff could be around for a while."
The channel connects Houston's port and refinery row to Galveston Bay and the Gulf of Mexico.
